profile.headline: Engineering @ Lead
profile.summary: Adventurous engineer who enjoys complex problems in the web3 and startup space.

positions.title: Technical Co-Founder
positions.description:
I built a solution that enables packages to be shipped out monthly with a focus on scalability on the operations side. We create and mail the final products, so the system manages inventory, integrates with payment processors, tax recorders, and shipping services, allows for one-off purchases, and internal reporting.

I created automated processes to help increase the package ship rate and set up support channels for customers and business partners alike.

Scala, Lift, AWS, PostgreSQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I built an invoicing tool for a Fortune 500 customer and a proof of concept for a client's messaging flow. 

I was also able to improve out some of our internal toolings. I was given the space to create where I saw need. I wrote several ChatOps plugins for Hubot which lowered the barrier of entry for any future new developer on the team and increased efficiency daily. Some of these scripts also lowered the DevOps overhead and reduced permissions needed by individual developers. I was able to open source some of these scripts and some scripts would gather 2,000-3,000 downloads a year. 

More Scala here with some Play framework added in. Node.js was also used.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
I led a team that included 6 distributed full stack developers and 2 designers. We built features and applications that allowed Elemica to unlock the full potential of the new engine and platform. These would go on to be the foundation of Elemica’s current product offerings.

As a developer, I was responsible for creating end-to-end solutions from the database to web UI.

I helped to implement code reviews and establish a collaborative remote culture. I was responsible for my team’s 1-1’s, year-end reviews, and sprint planning. I also was involved in direction planning with the CTO, directors, architects, and other stakeholders. 

Scala, Lift, Docker, HTML/CSS/Sass, Knockout.js, JavaScript/CoffeeScript, Selenium

positions.title: RnD Software Developer
positions.description:
Elemica wanted to upgrade its core supply chain platform to a flexible and scalable system and I was part of the team that investigated potential technologies and developed rapid functional prototypes for evaluation in the go-forward technology stack.

We built around different databases types, graph and NoSQL as well as languages including Scala.
